Everything is green. The implementation is complete at `/workspace/submission/main.py` (a single regular file, 24 KB, no external dependencies).

## Summary

**Validation layer** â rejects with exactly `{"error":"invalid-input"}` and exit 0:
- Size cap (8 MiB, exact boundary: a document of precisely 8388608 bytes is still accepted), strict UTF-8 decode, duplicate-object-key detection via `object_pairs_hook`, nonfinite rejection via `parse_constant` plus a `parse_float` finiteness hook (catches `1e999` overflows too), bool-vs-int discrimination via `type(x) is int`, exact key sets on every object, and every stated bound (zonesâ¤16, recordsâ¤1024 incl. duplicates, â¤64 distinct/RRset, CNAME target/coexistence/apex rules, profiles 1â8 with `max_aliases` 0â64, queriesâ¤20 with cost 1â1000, observationsâ¤64 with â¤128 answer entries and reference integrity).
- Names: label charset, 1â63 label length, â¤255 wire length, `*` as a literal label, ASCII lowercasing. Data: A octets with no leading zeros, AAAA via `ipaddress.IPv6Address` **with an explicit `%`-scope rejection** (3.11 accepts scope IDs), `.compressed` canonicalization, TXT 0â256 chars in U+0020âU+007E, CNAME as a canonical name.
- Nesting â¤ 32 containers, checked by a C-speed byte scanner (strings stripped by regex, then `bytes.translate` + `itertools.accumulate`) â proven exact against a naive reference on 30,000 valid documents and on all depth boundaries, so it can never falsely reject valid input and it prevents `RecursionError`.

**Resolver model** â the frozen loop exactly as specified: loop check first (beats authority/budget), most-specific zone re-selected at every CNAME target (root always matches), exact-name existence suppresses wildcard synthesis, closest-encloser with only `*.<encloser>` as the source ("prepend `*.` to the root"), empty-nonterminal/empty-wildcard sources, one-label depth requirement, CNAME queries answered without following, `CNAME_STOP`, `SERVFAIL/LIMIT` without the pending CNAME, `EXTERNAL` vs `OUTSIDE` by alias count, accumulated answers and traces on all terminations.

**Audits & diagnostic** â wire-projection comparison (rcode + deduped triple set), `["rcode","answer"]` divergence ordering, `unobserved` for timeouts; equivalence classes from projection signatures with class-array sorting; and an **exact** minimum-cost then minimum-count basis via a subset DP over â¤2Â²â° states (0.35 s, 95 MiB, verified against `ulimit -v`) with provably-safe domination pruning.

Testing: 176 invalid-input cases, ~80 hand-computed semantic/edge cases, 31 boundary cases, 22 stress cases, ~1400 randomized brute-force basis cross-checks, ~3900 randomized invariant-fuzzer documents, plus the official `check_examples.py` â all passing. A real bug in `parent_name` (single-label names broke root zones) was found and fixed by these tests.
